lines.say: Minus two seventy-six today. My bot made the same mistake three times. Watch.
Morning was easy. Four calls at seven thirty-five, all green. Up thirty-nine.
Nine twenty. It buys a stack of calls at once. Three hit the stop, minus twenty-five percent each.
Ten thirty, same thing again. Four more stops. Then my put spread stops out too. Minus fifty-eight.
Twelve thirty-five, five calls trail out green. Plus forty-four. Then twelve fifty, four more stops.
Twenty-seven trades, eleven stops at minus twenty-five percent. Should my bot stop stacking calls? Tell me below.
